findings.title: Overly Permissive Authenticated RLS Policy (Privilege Escalation)
findings.explanation: The policy allows ANY authenticated user (e.g. parent or student) full SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE access without verifying admin role.
findings.impact: A normal user can modify courses, assignments, enrollments, and teacher profiles across the platform.
findings.remediation: Restrict management policies to verify admin status: `USING ((auth.jwt() ->> 'role') = 'admin')` or `USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.users WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role IN ('admin', 'super_admin')))`.

findings.title: Insecure Role Assignment in Auth Trigger (Arbitrary Privilege Escalation)
findings.explanation: handle_new_user() reads raw_user_meta_data->>'role' directly from user signup. Any user can pass `role: "super_admin"` during registration.
findings.impact: Any public user can escalate their account to Super Admin and gain administrative access to dashboards and data.
findings.remediation: Hardcode the default role to 'parent' or 'student' inside handle_new_user(). Roles must only be elevated by existing admins via a secured server function.

findings.title: Unrestricted Public Access to Sensitive RSVP / PII Data
findings.explanation: Event RSVP records containing personal phone numbers, emails, and parent/student names are readable by unauthenticated public visitors.
findings.impact: Exposure of attendee PII (names, contact numbers, emails) to scraping and enumeration.
findings.remediation: Restrict SELECT on event_rsvps to admin users only or restrict parents to viewing only their own submitted RSVPs.

findings.title: Overly Permissive Image Optimization & SVG Handling
findings.explanation: `next.config.ts` allows arbitrary remote hostnames (`**`) over http and https, combined with `dangerouslyAllowSVG: true`.
findings.impact: Potential Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via image proxy, resource exhaustion, and SVG-based Stored XSS if un-sanitized SVGs are uploaded.
findings.remediation: Restrict remotePatterns to trusted CDNs (e.g., Supabase storage, Unsplash) and ensure SVGs are sanitized with DOMPurify.
